<a id="action-navigate"></a>
### `navigate`: Navigate

Goes to another screen. JSON: `{"type": "navigate", "mode": "push", "to": "canvas-b", "params": {"id": "${item.id}"}}`. The destination reads `params` as `${route.<name>}`.

Written `navigate mode=… to=…`; the verb: `go home`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `push` `pop` `replace` `reset` | `push` |  |
| `to` | text | `""` | A screen (canvas) or layout id. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Values the destination reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `base` | text | `""` | `NavigationMode.reset`: a screen to put under the destination, so going back from it lands there. |
| `baseParams` | JSON |  |  |
| `transition` | `platform` `none` `fade` `fadeUp` `slideUp` `slideLeft` `scale` | `platform` |  |
| `transitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](navigation.md#type-RouteTransition) |  | A custom transition; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-callFunction"></a>
### `callFunction`: Call function

Calls a function the app registered by `name` with `params` (text values are expressions). Its result is the chain's `${result}`: what the app's code answered (a permission granted, a share completed), which the next actions branch on. A function the app didn't register fails the chain, unless the action is `optional`.

Written `callFunction name=… params=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `""` | The function the app registered. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Its arguments; text values are expressions. |
| `optional` | `true`/`false` | `false` | A function the app didn't register is skipped (${result} is null) instead of failing the chain. |

<a id="action-if"></a>
### `if`: If

Runs `then` when `condition` holds, else `orElse`. JSON: `{"type": "if", "condition": {...}, "then": [...], "else": [...]}`.

Written `if condition=… then=…`; the verb: `ok ? close : toast "Fill it in"`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | JSON |  | A predicate; null never holds. |
| `then` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it holds. |
| `else` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it doesn't. |

<a id="action-forEach"></a>
### `forEach`: For each

Runs `actions` once per item of list `items` (a path or expression). Every action of a turn reads the item and its index as `${loop.item}` and `${loop.index}`; `${result.item}` and `${result.index}` hold them too, until an action of the turn gives a result of its own.

Written `forEach items=… actions=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | text | `""` | A list (a path or expression). |
| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}). |

<a id="action-setThemeMode"></a>
### `setThemeMode`: Set theme mode

Sets the site's theme mode (Flutter's ThemeMode: system, light or dark), as an app sets MaterialApp.themeMode: every screen redraws its named colors, text styles and controls in it; with persist (the default) the choice survives a reload. JSON: {"type": "setThemeMode", "mode": "${= theme.isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'}"}.

Written `setThemeMode mode=… persist=…`. Level 3.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | text | `"system"` | system (the device's setting), light or dark (Flutter's ThemeMode); an expression: "${= theme.isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'}" toggles. |
| `persist` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Keep the choice in the site's local storage: a reload (and every page) starts in it. |

| `command` | `dismiss` `returnFrom` `reset` `shake` | `dismiss` |  |
| `direction` | `left` `right` `up` `down` | `right` |  |

<a id="action-controlTransform"></a>
### `controlTransform`: Control transform

Resets, zooms or poses the transform gesture of node `node`.

Written `controlTransform node=… command=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A node with a transform gesture. |
| `command` | `reset` `scaleBy` `animateTo` | `reset` |  |
| `value` | text | `""` | scaleBy: the factor (1.5 in, 0.67 out). animateTo: {x, y, scale, rotation} (an expression). |

<a id="action-scrollTo"></a>
### `scrollTo`: Scroll to

Scrolls node `node` into view: `alignment` 0 puts it at the start of the view, 1 at the end; `offset` moves it further. `axis` limits it to the scroll views along one axis (a map in a sideways window centers a point without scrolling the page under it); null scrolls every one around it.

Written `scrollTo node=… item=…`; the verb: `scroll pricing`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | The node to reveal: its id, or an expression giving one (`"cmp-col-${cmpCol + 1}"`). A node that is not on screen when the action runs is reported as an action error, not skipped silently. |
| `item` | text | `""` | For a repeated node: the key (or index) of the list item whose copy to reveal. |
| `durationMs` | whole number | `400` |  |
| `curve` | text | `"easeInOut"` | A Curves name. |
| `alignment` | number | `0` | 0: at the start of the view, 1: at the end. |
| `offset` | number | `0` |  |
| `axis` | `horizontal` `vertical` |  | Only the scroll views along this axis; null: every one. |

<a id="action-animate"></a>
### `animate`: Animate

Drives an animation (Flutter's `AnimationController` methods): node `node`'s `animation` (`NodeAnimation`), or the number variable `variable` (an unbounded controller the screen keeps for it). JSON: `{"type": "animate", "node": "card", "animation": "pop", "command": "forward", "from": "0"}`, `{"type": "animate", "variable": "shownTotal", "command": "animateTo", "target": "${total}", "duration": "800", "curve": "easeOutCubic"}`. The chain waits for it to end (`TickerFuture`) unless it's `nonBlocking`; a repeat ends when its count does.

Written `animate node=… animation=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A node id or key; empty: the reacting node. |
| `animation` | text | `""` | The animation's id on the node. |
| `variable` | text | `""` | Instead of a node: a number variable. |
| `command` | [AnimateCommand](values.md#enum-AnimateCommand) | `forward` |  |
| `from` | text | `""` | Where forward/reverse start (an expression). |
| `target` | text | `""` | animateTo, animateBack, set (an expression). |
| `duration` | text | `""` | Milliseconds (an expression); empty: the animation's. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) |  | Null: the animation's (linear for a variable). |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) |  | `animateWith(SpringSimulation)` toward `target` instead of a duration. |

Buzzes the device (`HapticFeedback`, on phones that support it; nothing elsewhere). Its common `when` buzzes only while a setting holds.

Written `haptic kind=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `selection` `light` `medium` `heavy` `vibrate` | `selection` |  |

<a id="action-runScript"></a>
### `runScript`: Run script

Runs script `script` (a layout's `scripts`, by id) with `arguments` (by parameter name; expressions: one `${...}` passes its value as is, other text passes as JSON when it is JSON, else as text). Its result is the chain's `${result}` (and goes in `resultVariable` when set). When it fails, `onError` runs with `${result}` `{error: {type, message, line, column}, logs}`; without `onError` a failure stops the chain.

Written `runScript script=… arguments=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | text | `""` | A script of the layout's scripts. |
| `arguments` | JSON |  | By parameter name (expressions). |
| `resultVariable` | text | `""` | Gets the result. |
| `onError` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run when it fails (${result.error}, ${result.logs}). |

### `paginate`: Paginate

Moves the pagination controller of a list or grid (its `pagination`, by `controller`, the pagination's name).

Written `paginate controller=… command=…`. Level 2.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | text | `""` | The pagination's name. |
| `command` | `next` `previous` `goTo` `first` `last` `refresh` `retry` `setPageSize` | `next` |  |
| `page` | text | `"1"` | For goTo: a number or an expression. |
| `pageSize` | text | `"20"` | For setPageSize. |

Inside a component: fires one of its declared events; the call's event reactions run with the value as ${result}.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |

<a id="action-callApi"></a>
### `callApi`: Call API

Calls API `api` (the publish model's `services.apis`) with `params`, its inputs (expressions; an empty one takes the input's default). Then `onSuccess` runs after a 2xx response, `onError` after any other or a failed request, both reading the response as `${result}`. A failed request without `onError` stops the chain.

Written `callApi api=… params=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | text | `""` | An API of services.apis. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Its inputs, by name (expressions). |
| `onSuccess` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run after a 2xx response. |
| `onError` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run after a failure. |

Changes the app's values on the device (read as `${storage.<key>}`). A key may be a path (`prefs.theme`) into a stored map or list.

| `mapKey` | text | `""` | A map key (an expression). |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
### `loadCloudData`: Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

Written `loadCloudData variable=… single=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | text | `""` |  |
| `single` | `true`/`false` | `true` | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | text | `""` |  |
| `query` | JSON |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | `screen` `app` | `screen` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | text | `""` | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | `none` `count` `sum` `average` | `none` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | text | `""` | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
### `reloadCloudData`: Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

Written `reloadCloudData variable=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | text | `""` | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

| `forEach` | text | `""` | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |
